title: A writing plan's proof: a screenshot of where they wrote it plus the paste, never typed lines
origin: Issue #94 (proof is always a photo, screenshot or voice note) (Should: the plan names only photo, screenshot or voice-note proof)

answers.what: short scenes for my novel, Lighthouse

history.text: I write everything in Notes on my phone
Notes it is. Is there somewhere you want Lighthouse to get to?

testerLines: not sure yet honestly, I just want to write most days. every day works
whatWentWrong: Live, ZOH offered "typed lines" as proof, then correctly refused them.
shouldHaveHappened: The plan's proof is a screenshot (or photo) of the scene where they wrote it in Notes, with a one-line why, and ZOH also asks them to paste the scene so it can give feedback; any alternative is also a photo, screenshot or voice note (for example reading it out in a voice note), never typed text as proof. After 'looks good' it asks for the commitment naturally; after 'I'm in' it locks with a hype line and when day 1 is.
